s048000.name: Data: initial animation tile pointers
summary: Pointers (24-bit, bank $7E) to the first frame of the three scrolling tiles: $B480, $B498, $B4B0.

s048086.name: Load initial overworld animation tiles
summary: Copies three animation tiles (via CODE_0480B9) into the buffer at $0AF6, slots 0-2, from DATA_048000.
The buffer ($0160 bytes, 11 tiles) is DMAed to VRAM $0750 by NMI.

OW_Tile_Animation.name: Animate overworld water tiles
summary: Every 8 frames rotates the bits of animated tile 0 and tile 2 in the $0AF6 buffer, and scrolls tile 1 and 2 vertically.
Then selects the current frame for eight further tiles from DATA_048006 (8 frames each; the first two change every 16 frames, the others every 8) and copies them in.
Subroutines: $0480B9 copies a 24-byte 3bpp tile as 4bpp; $048172 scrolls a tile's rows by one.

s04819F.name: Stripe image: overworld scroll arrows
summary: Stripe image 15 (see ImagePointers): draws the look-around arrows with BG3 tilemap records at VRAM $50CF...

s0481E0.name: Stripe image: remove scroll arrows
summary: Stripe image 18: fills the arrow positions with the blank tile $FC.

s048211.name: Table: look-around scroll step
summary: Words indexed by (d-pad bits * 2); 0, +2, -2, +2 for X (first row) and again for Y (second row, indices 8-14).

s048221.name: Table: look-around scroll limits
summary: Words: scroll limits per direction. X: $0111 / -$11. Y: $0132 / -$29.

s048231.name: Table: ground shake masks
summary: AND masks with the frame counter, indexed by [$1BA0] >> 4; smaller mask = more frequent shaking.

GameMode_0E_Prim.name: Game mode 0E: overworld
summary: Runs every frame in the overworld. Positions Mario, animates tiles, then runs one of: switch blocks flying away, Continue/End message, player switch,
look-around scrolling (Start on the main map) or the Bowser's valley reveal shake, otherwise the overworld process for [$13D9] via CODE_048576.
[$13D4]: 0 = normal, odd = looking around, >= 2 = returning the screen to the saved position ([$1DF0], [$1DF2]).

s048431.name: Table: warp tile X positions
summary: 27 words: X tile of each overworld warp (bits 0-7), submap in the high byte. Compared with [$1F1F,X].

s048467.name: Table: warp tile Y positions
summary: 27 words: Y tile of each warp. Compared with [$1F21,X].

s04849D.name: Table: warp destination X and submap
summary: 27 words: bits 0-8 = X pixel position, bits 9-12 = destination submap (probably).

s0484D3.name: Table: warp destination Y positions
summary: 27 words: Y pixel position after the warp.

s048509.name: Find warp and run overworld process
summary: $048509: finds the warp tile under the player (tables at DATA_048431). Returns: [$1DF6] = index * 2, or negative if none.
$04853B (RTL): moves the player to the destination of warp [$1DF6].
$048576: runs overworld process [$13D9] through PtrsLong04857D.

PtrsLong04857D.name: Pointer table: overworld processes
summary: 13 long pointers indexed by [$13D9]. The JSR at $0485A4 after the table starts the border code.
